timing.scope: Synchronized training wall time: objective, backward, AdamW and Python dispatch. Excludes batch generation, transfers, model setup, evaluation, and parity. Compile mode wraps the forward objective with fullgraph=True; optimizer runs outside.
timing.first_use: First training step in this process includes first-use overhead and execution. Not a measurement of isolated compiler time.
timing.steady_definition: Throughput after the first full post-first-step block; residual compilation is possible.
